mapper.select: SELECT *, CASE WHEN api_key IS NOT NULL AND api_key != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS api_key_configured, CASE WHEN api_secret IS NOT NULL AND api_secret != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS api_secret_configured FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_ai_config WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND status = 1 ORDER BY priority DESC, sort_order DESC

SELECT *, CASE WHEN api_key IS NOT NULL AND api_key != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS api_key_configured, CASE WHEN api_secret IS NOT NULL AND api_secret != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS api_secret_configured FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_ai_config WHERE is_default = 1 AND is_enabled = 1 AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
